location: Valley floor / Ridge line descending to camp
physicalConditions: The valley floor is bathed in the pale, cool light of the setting sun.
The barrier has retracted into a stable, dormant state (pale indigo mist) and is knitting shut.
The channel/conduit has collapsed; no longer resonating or singing.
The oppressive fog has completely retreated; the valley floor is bathed in crisp, cool air.
The shrine stone has cooled significantly.
Kaelen's brass gauntlet is cold, inert, and silent (no longer exerting magnetic drag).
Kaelen is experiencing residual physical ache and fatigue from regulating the flow.
The drainage ditches are dark and still, free of green corruption glow.
Streetlamps in the distant city are flickering on.
The ground is firm now, devoid of the oily slickness that had coated their boots earlier.
knowledgeEstablished: The local threat is neutralized; the Blight cannot sustain itself without the source.
The barrier functions as a dormant scar rather than an active predator.
Kaelen successfully regulated the flow and listened to his own limits, preventing burnout.
The party has confirmed the area is safe for departure.
Elara has collected intact quartz fragments for later study/cataloging.
The victory was born of patience rather than power; the Blight was starved until its reservoir drained.
decisionsMade: Elias ordered Maren and Torin to check the perimeter before leaving.
Maren and Torin agreed to move toward the ridge to verify the area is clear.
Elara decided to document resonance patterns for guild records.
The group resolved to return to camp before the night gets colder.
Elias instructed Kaelen to rest before moving another mile.
The party has agreed to leave in ten minutes after packing up.
possessionChanges: Elara has packed her tools and retained larger quartz fragments in her satchel.
relationshipChanges: Trust and confidence are high; the party acknowledges the cost paid by Kaelen without resentment.
Kaelen accepts his role as a regulator who learned to stop pushing, receiving praise from Elias.
completedActions: Elias exhaled slowly and watched Kaelen lean against a dead oak.
Kaelen pushed himself upright with an effort that made his face grimace.
Maren stepped up beside them and confirmed the barrier is knitting shut.
Elara knelt by the fissure, inspected the collapsed conduit with a magnifying lens, and gathered her satchel.
Torin checked his sword and looked toward the ridge.
Elias placed a hand on Kaelen's shoulder to ground him.
The party moved carefully away from the shrine, stepping over the cooling stone.
Maren spoke about the fog not returning and the stars appearing.
Torin noted the possibility of regeneration or interference by others.
Elias smiled faintly and stated that tonight they rest and tomorrow they move on.
Kaelen nodded, leaned heavily on Torin's arm for a moment before finding his own balance.
Elara adjusted her pack and secured the last of her tools inside.
The companions turned away from the shrine and began the descent toward their campsite.
unresolvedImmediateAction: The party is walking along the ridge line descending toward their campsite, with Kaelen leaning on Torin's arm for support as they move out of the valley clearing.
continuationPosition: The characters are stepping carefully over the cooling stone and darkened fissure, moving out of the valley clearing. Elias is speaking to Kaelen about resting, while Elara packs her tools. The barrier has faded completely behind them.
